name: Verify photon combat disablement after game-server restart

tests.name: Read the durable shot target and sector

data.sql: SELECT sector_id,target_ship_id FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE request_id='photon-restart-persist-001';

tests.name: Reauthenticate and retry the committed shot after server restart
Restart retry leaves the original single debit and receipt

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT photons FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_restart_shooter'))=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE request_id='photon-restart-persist-001')=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.photon_fired.v1' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_restart_shooter'))=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Reauthenticate and read persisted photon state
Persisted photon disablement still blocks attacks after restart

expect.message: Photon-disabled combat systems cannot initiate attacks or fire weapons
